rake build                                # Build demo_gem-0.1.0.gem into the pkg directory
rake build:checksum                       # Generate SHA512 checksum of demo_gem-0.1.0.gem into the checksums directory
rake clean                                # Remove any temporary products
rake clobber                              # Remove any generated files
rake install                              # Build and install demo_gem-0.1.0.gem into system gems
rake install:local                        # Build and install demo_gem-0.1.0.gem into system gems without network access
rake release[remote]                      # Create tag v0.1.0 and build and push demo_gem-0.1.0.gem to TODO: Set to your gem server 'https://example.com'
rake release:guard_clean                  # 
rake release:rubygem_push                 # 
rake release:source_control_push[remote]  # 
rake test                                 # Run the test suite
rake test:cmd                             # Print out the test command
rake test:deps                            # 
rake test:isolated                        # Show which test files fail when run in isolation
rake test:slow                            # Show bottom 25 tests wrt time
